name: HyperSoft Technologies Limited
about: HyperSoft Technologies Limited provides information technology consulting, software development, digital transformation, cloud, data and artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, enterprise application, and managed services in India and internationally. The company offers digital consulting, enterprise applications, and cloud services; AI strategy and adoption, AI assistants and copilots, knowledge management, large language model integration, generative AI consulting, conversational AI chatbots, retrieval augmented generation, and AI governance and prompt engineering services; data engineering, business intelligence, data lakehouse, and predictive analytics services; robotic process automation, intelligent document processing, hyper automation, workflow automation, and process mining services; and security operations center, cloud security, identity and access management, zero trust security, vulnerability assessment and penetration testing, and compliance and risk management services. It also offers cloud assessment, cloud modernization, backup and disaster recovery, migration services, cloud security, and cloud managed services; legacy modernization, API management, event-driven architecture, microservices architecture, and containerization services; custom software development, quality engineering, agile delivery, web and mobile applications, and DevSecOps services; and infrastructure management, cloud operations, service desk, application support, database administration, and network operations services. It serves healthcare and life sciences, transportation and logistics, government and public sector, retail and ecommerce, banking and capital markets, insurance, manufacturing, and energy and utilities. HyperSoft Technologies Limited was incorporated in 1983 and is based in Hyderabad, India.
